topic: Particle arrangement and motion in states of matter
key_concepts: Solid particles are closely packed in a fixed, regular pattern
Solid particles vibrate in fixed positions with minimal relative motion
Solid particles have small spaces between them
Intermolecular forces are very strong in solids
Liquid particles are close together but more loosely arranged than solids
Liquid particles slide past each other and flow
Liquid particles have more relative motion than solid particles
Liquid particles have small spaces that are larger than in solids
Intermolecular forces in liquids are weaker than in solids
Gas particles are far apart and have no fixed arrangement
Gas particles move rapidly, freely, and randomly in all directions
Gas particles have very large spaces between them compared with solids and liquids
